cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.20)
project(EmberFixedUvObserverAbi LANGUAGES C)
if(NOT WIN32 OR NOT MSVC OR NOT CMAKE_SIZEOF_VOID_P EQUAL 8 OR NOT MSVC_VERSION EQUAL 1944)
  message(FATAL_ERROR "The fixed observer ABI control requires the selected Windows x64 MSVC toolchain.")
endif()
foreach(required EMBER_ABI_CONTROL_C EMBER_OBSERVER_OBJECT EMBER_UV_INCLUDE)
  if(NOT EXISTS "${${required}}")
    message(FATAL_ERROR "The fixed observer ABI control inputs are unavailable.")
  endif()
endforeach()
set(CMAKE_C_STANDARD 11)
set(CMAKE_C_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)
set(CMAKE_MSVC_RUNTIME_LIBRARY MultiThreaded)
set_source_files_properties("${EMBER_OBSERVER_OBJECT}" PROPERTIES EXTERNAL_OBJECT TRUE GENERATED TRUE)
add_executable(ember_uv_observer_abi_control "${EMBER_ABI_CONTROL_C}" "${EMBER_OBSERVER_OBJECT}")
target_include_directories(ember_uv_observer_abi_control PRIVATE "${EMBER_UV_INCLUDE}")
target_compile_definitions(ember_uv_observer_abi_control PRIVATE _WIN32_WINNT=0x0602 EMBER_UV_FIXED_PROBE_OFFLINE=1)
target_compile_options(ember_uv_observer_abi_control PRIVATE /W4 /we4013 /utf-8 /GS)
target_link_libraries(ember_uv_observer_abi_control PRIVATE kernel32)
